en: A monochrome historical postcard showing a broad unpaved street of a Russian town, seen from an elevated wooden walkway with railings. Wooden one‑ and two‑story houses line both sides of the long straight road, with people walking and a horse‑drawn cart visible. In the distance stands a large white Orthodox church with multiple domes and towers. Russian text in pre‑revolutionary orthography is printed at the top and bottom of the image.
